claim: spec/adapters/arch_br_reference_adapter.md's "Op Translation" > "retarget op → br update" section (line 122): "...then one `br update --add-label <label>` per entry of `op.Labels` ... followed by one `br update --add-dep <edge>:<bead-id>` per resolved dep the bead does not already carry...". spec/adapters/flow_adapter.md echoes the same claim twice: phase 2 (line 6) "...then runs `br update` — one add per event label, one per missing dep..." and "Subprocess Shape" (line 19) "`br update` once per dep a retarget's target does not already carry." module.json's requirement fcb32354630e ("Apply retarget ops") states the adapter "add[s] any deps the task does not already carry" via "the tracker's update surface — for br, br update". test_idempotency.md's "Retarget: first run" scenario (lines 73-75) likewise expects "one dep-add for `br-dep2`" to go through the same `br update` call as the label add.
authoritative_source: The real `br` CLI installed on PATH in this environment (`br --version` → `br 0.2.16`, the only tracker this reference adapter can be verified against). `br update --help`'s full flag listing has no dependency-mutation flag of any name (`--add-label`/`--remove-label`/`--set-labels` exist for labels; `--parent` exists for reparenting; nothing exists for deps). Dependency mutation lives on a separate subcommand tree: `br dep add <ISSUE> <DEPENDS_ON> --type <DEP_TYPE>` ("Add a dependency: <issue> depends on <depends-on>"). arch_br_reference_adapter.md's own "Dependencies" section (line 25) is corroborating: it lists the br subcommand surface this adapter needs as exactly `create`, `list --json`, `show <id> --format json`, `update`, `close` — `dep add` is not on that list at all, even though the retarget requirement (this same file, 60 lines later) requires dependency mutation the listed surface cannot perform.
evidence: Ran `br update --add-dep blocks:spexmachina-x some-id` against the real `br` binary on PATH: exits non-zero with `error: unexpected argument '--add-dep' found` and clap's own suggestion is the unrelated `--add-label` (`tip: a similar argument exists: '--add-label'`) — confirming no dep-related flag has ever existed on `update` for clap to suggest instead. `br create --deps <type:id,...>` (used correctly by the create path already implemented in scripts/apply-br.sh) proves the CLI *does* support attaching deps at creation time, which makes the retarget requirement's specific choice to route deps through `update` rather than `dep add` look like a copy-paste of the create op's `--deps` flag onto a subcommand that has no equivalent, rather than a deliberate contract. Since no `br` version accepts `--add-dep` on `update` and the retarget path is new work this bead must add (scripts/apply-br.sh currently has zero retarget handling — `grep -n retarget scripts/apply-br.sh` returns nothing), the dep-sync half of the retarget requirement cannot be implemented as literally specified against any real tracker call; implementing it against the actual `br dep add` subcommand instead would silently contradict the arch leaf's explicit, repeated `br update --add-dep` claim, which is exactly the kind of unilateral spec deviation the drift protocol exists to avoid.
proposed_fix: Replace `br update --add-dep <edge>:<bead-id>` with `br dep add <target-bead-id> <dep-bead-id> --type <edge>` in arch_br_reference_adapter.md's retarget section (and rename the section head, since the dep half no longer goes through 'the update surface'), in flow_adapter.md's phase-2 paragraph and Subprocess Shape bullet (both currently say the dep-add reuses `br update`), and in module.json's fcb32354630e description. Add `dep add` to the required-subcommand list in the "Dependencies" section (line 25). Confirm the edge-type default (`blocked-by`, per the create-op mapping in the same file) is a value `br dep add --type` accepts, or reconcile it with the type vocabulary `br dep add --help` documents (`blocks, parent-child, related, etc.`) — the create path's `--deps blocked-by:<id>` shorthand and `dep add --type blocked-by` may not agree on spelling. Update test_idempotency.md's retarget scenarios to describe the `br dep add` invocation instead of a second `br update` call.
